problem_statement: The prior terminal F16/Q4 recovery conclusions were correct for the GitHub/repository sources actually inspected, but their downstream wording over-constrained research continuation by treating absence from GitHub-hosted persistence as if it were global artifact unavailability.

correction.source_not_found_scope: A NOT_FOUND/UNAVAILABLE result applies only to the explicitly inspected source set and venue. It must not be interpreted as proof that the artifact cannot exist or cannot be reproducibly materialized elsewhere.

validity_requirements: exact source/model/runtime identities frozen before outcome
artifact hashes and sizes frozen after execution
venue-specific binaries recorded rather than assumed byte-identical across operating systems

local_windows_path.q4_if_present_locally: If model-q4_k_m.gguf exists locally and exact size/SHA256/manifest match the frozen Q4 identity, it may be admitted directly for M6 local Ollama qualification.
local_windows_path.f16_if_present_locally: If model-f16.gguf exists locally and exact size/SHA256/manifest match the frozen F16 identity, it may be admitted and used for the already-authorized deterministic Q4_K_M reconstruction.
local_windows_path.if_neither_binary_exists: A separate pre-outcome deterministic local artifact-regeneration program may recreate F16 from the exact frozen model revision/converter contract and then Q4_K_M from the exact frozen llama.cpp source/quantizer contract. This is artifact reproducibility/materialization, not a model-quality scientific rerun, provided no fixtures/inference/adjudication are executed during regeneration.

next_valid_action: OPEN_LOCAL_WINDOWS_M6_VENUE_QUALIFICATION_AND_PREOUTCOME_EXECUTION_PACKAGE; discover/admit local Q4 or F16 first, otherwise preregister deterministic local artifact regeneration before any regeneration command
